## How nidirect uses cookies

The nidirect website uses some essential cookies to make this service work. nidirect would like to set extra cookies to remember your settings, understand how people use the service, and make improvements. Some of nidirect’s pages allow chosen third parties to set cookies – for example, pages that contain YouTube videos or Google Maps.

Find out more about how nidirect uses cookies

# Roe Valley Country Park, Limavady

This picturesque and peaceful park on the outskirts of Limavady offers riverside woodland walks along the River Roe.

## Entrance is free

You can explore the area's cultural past and the historical remnants of the industry that once thrived there to harness the power of the river. Seasonal salmon and trout fishing is available under permit from the local angling club. There are picnic facilities and a café on-site.
